cards.title: Purify 1.9 is here.
cards.text: Purify 1.9 keeps a journal with you by the Church's day, free for everyone, opens every verse to its Greek, and brings six more Bibles to download.
cards.from: the caption's first sentence, and the drop's line
cards.state: Today on 6 December 2026, the new reader's one-question card dismissed with its own Dismiss button.
cards.alt: Today: St Nicholas the Wonderworker, the Nativity Fast with fish allowed, and the day's verse.

cards.title: Your journal, by the Church's day
cards.text: Today's page shows the feast or saints and readings, each with a pen to begin a page. Add verse cards and highlights, export it, or print it on the website. Free for everyone.
cards.from: the drop's point "journal": its name and its text
cards.state: The journal as a new reader opens it: the day's page, its saint, its fast and its readings, each with a pen.
cards.alt: The journal's page for Sunday: the day's saint, the fast, and the Epistle and Gospel, each with a pen.

cards.title: Every verse, opened
cards.text: Hold a verse to highlight it, copy it, share it as a picture, write a note and see its Greek.
cards.from: the drop's point "verse": its name and its text
cards.state: John 1 with a finger held on verse 1: its own tools, open.
cards.alt: John 1:1 held open: the highlight colours, and Copy, Share, Image, Note and Study.

cards.title: Six more Bibles
cards.text: The Russian Synodal, the Greek Septuagint, the Serbian of Karadžić and Daničić, and three labelled Protestant: the Arabic Van Dyck, Spanish Reina-Valera and Portuguese Almeida.
cards.from: the drop's point "bibles": its name and its text
cards.state: John 1 with the translations list open (the KJV button under the chapter), drawn up to the Bibles to download.
cards.alt: The translations list: the Russian Synodal, the Greek Septuagint and the Serbian Bible, each to download.

cards.title: Study a verse, in Purify Plus
cards.text: Cross-references into the Septuagint, the Greek of every word, Compare across your Bibles, and Remember the verse in three steps.
cards.from: the drop's point "study": its name and its text
cards.state: John 1:1 held, then Study: the verse's study sheet as a reader with no Plus meets it, each Plus part under its mark.
cards.alt: The study sheet for John 1:1: the Greek, and Cross-references and Compare marked Purify Plus.

cards.title: The Scriptures, the saints, the prayers and the calendar stay free.
cards.text: Find Purify: Orthodox Hub on the App Store and on Google Play.
cards.from: the drop's closing, and the caption's last sentence
